_comment: ADD OR REMOVE TOOLS HERE AND NOWHERE ELSE. index.html builds itself from this file; each tool page reads its own title and accent from it via nav.js. 'id' must be unique and must match the ?tool= value if the page is shared (e.g. the digest engine).

sections.name: Literature & evidence
sections.blurb: Live PubMed and registry queries. Nothing is cached server-side; every result comes from the source at the moment you load it.

tools.name: Neuro-oncology digest
tools.desc: Recent literature across glioma, skull base, stereotactic radiosurgery and ocular tumours.

tools.name: Lower GI digest
tools.desc: Recent literature across rectal, colon, anal and appendiceal cancer, plus contact X-ray brachytherapy.

tools.name: Journal browser
tools.desc: Table of contents across the radiation and clinical oncology journals, filtered to what you follow.

tools.name: UK trial finder
tools.desc: ClinicalTrials.gov search restricted to studies with a recruiting or active UK site.

sections.name: Clinical calculators
sections.blurb: Bedside and clinic tools. All calculation happens in your browser — nothing is transmitted anywhere.

tools.name: Constraints & fractionation
tools.desc: Organ-at-risk dose constraints and standard schedules for neuro and lower GI, sourced row by row.

tools.name: Steroid equivalence & taper
tools.desc: Glucocorticoid conversion, graduated dexamethasone taper, and the PJP and glucose monitoring the dose triggers.

tools.name: Follow-up scheduler
tools.desc: Builds a surveillance schedule from an index date, skips bank holidays, exports to calendar or clipboard.

tools.name: Geriatric assessment
tools.desc: G8, PGA, CARG chemotoxicity, Katz ADL, Lawton IADL and GO-PIMS in one place.

tools.name: NHS pay calculator
tools.desc: Take-home pay for the 2026/27 medical and dental pay scales, with pension tiers and student loan plans.
